generationContext.text:
<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <Description>This is the client library for the Conversations service, a cloud-based conversational AI service that applies custom machine-learning intelligence to a user's conversational, natural language text to predict overall meaning, and pull out relevant, detailed information.</Description>
    <AssemblyTitle>Microsoft Azure.AI.Language.Conversations client library</AssemblyTitle>
    <Version>2.0.0-beta.6</Version>
    <!--The ApiCompatVersion is managed automatically and should not generally be modified manually.-->
    <ApiCompatVersion>1.1.0</ApiCompatVersion>
    <PackageTags>Azure AI Language Conversations</PackageTags>
    <TargetFrameworks>$(RequiredTargetFrameworks)</TargetFrameworks>
    <IncludeOperationsSharedSource>true</IncludeOperationsSharedSource>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Azure.Core" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Shared source from Azure.Core -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ArrayBufferWriter.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)AzureKeyCredentialPolicy.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)AzureResourceProviderNamespaceAttribute.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
    <Compile Include="$(AzureCoreSharedSources)ExperimentalAttribute.cs" LinkBase="Shared" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

proposals.subtype: Error-level deprecation of retained authoring client type
proposals.explanation: ConversationAuthoringClient is retained as a public type but is marked Obsolete with isError true and a migration-information URL. This finding counts that explicit type-level retirement marker, not each unsupported operation stub as a functional customization.

proposals.subtype: Typed synchronous analysis waits and unwraps operation result
proposals.explanation: The typed overload validates its input, converts it to disposable RequestContent, adapts cancellation to RequestContext and invokes the protocol overload with WaitUntil.Completed. limitations: Only seven of 322 eligible files from 361 discovered files are captured. Empty skipped/errors arrays do not demonstrate complete discovery or absence of other customizations.
The supplied .NET guideline treats non-generated src files as handwritten, despite unknown extraction kind. Mapping attributes provide additional direct signals for type/member name edits.

ConversationAuthoringClient is an error-obsolete compatibility surface containing many NotSupportedException stubs, empty key constructors and an auto-get Pipeline property. Those bodies are not counted as functioning LRO, pager, authentication or convenience implementations; the reported type finding is its explicit error-level obsolescence.

Generated client/model partials, submit-operation request builders, implicit model/request/response conversions and shared ProtocolOperationHelpers are absent. The four operational LRO findings are visible wrappers and wait/result adaptations, not independently inspected polling machinery.

The audience type and options property are internal, and no captured constructor consumes the option. Comments alone do not establish public audience configuration, actual bearer scopes or default-cloud behavior.
No compilation, generator execution or service requests were performed; compile-time attributes and source branches are measured, not verified runtime behavior or exhaustive package-level absence.
Only seven of 322 eligible source files were captured (361 discovered); this review cannot establish package-wide completeness or absence of other handwritten customizations.

Generated counterparts and the shared operation-processing helper were not supplied; the source establishes explicit non-generated wrappers and mappings, not the generated implementation or polling algorithm.

The captured code does not show a consuming client constructor for ConversationsClientOptions.Audience or ConversationsAudience, so authentication scope selection, defaulting, and end-to-end cloud behavior remain unverified.
The authoring client is error-level obsolete and its provided operation bodies throw NotSupportedException; retained signatures are not evidence of working LRO or pagination.

No distinct omission is supported by the captured source beyond the proposed behaviors: the empty model-factory partial has only its name mapping, and the unsupported authoring stubs are not separately counted as functioning customization instances.
